name: Ronnie Foster
hook: A jazz organist whose Blue Note debut gave A Tribe Called Quest the keyboard loop of 'Electric Relaxation'.

blurb.age7: A jazz organ player. A Tribe Called Quest used a piece of his music in one of their best songs.
blurb.age13: Ronnie Foster is an organist from Buffalo, New York. His first album, Two Headed Freap, came out on the jazz label Blue Note in 1972. One track, 'Mystic Brew', has a soft, melancholy keyboard phrase. In 1993 A Tribe Called Quest looped it for 'Electric Relaxation', and it's been sampled and covered many times since.
blurb.adult: Foster is on the map as a sample hub (Q21). 'Mystic Brew' is a clear case of a jazz label's catalogue becoming a hip-hop producer's library: Blue Note's 1970s records were among the most mined sources of the 1990s.
